round2_position.mechanism_claim_status: No material-mechanism validity claim is made in this round.
round2_position.A_route_update: A route remains baseline-first: graph quantities are only admissible as residual predictors after orbital-overlap, onsite variance, carrier density, mobility-edge margin, batch and finite-size controls.

source_status_from_round1.label: Srivastava et al. 2019
source_status_from_round1.available_in_read_scope: metadata/abstract-level baseline claim from C2_round1; exact full-text/SI constants were not available in the provided read scope

missing_SI_or_normalization_items.needed_detail: Which atomic orbitals enter the overlap integral, especially whether the implemented center set is only metal-s or includes species-specific orbital mixtures.
missing_SI_or_normalization_items.why_needed: Defines the graph edge set and prevents graph features from being computed on a different structural object than the baseline.

missing_SI_or_normalization_items.needed_detail: Exact radial functional form and all species-pair parameters; Round 1 used exp(-d_ij/rho_ij) only as a proxy.
missing_SI_or_normalization_items.why_needed: Controls the numerical scale and monotonicity of O_s.

missing_SI_or_normalization_items.needed_detail: Whether the total overlap is normalized by N_pair, atom count, volume, composition-weighted pair counts, or another sample-size/composition factor.
missing_SI_or_normalization_items.why_needed: Distinguishes physical overlap density from trivial finite-size or composition scaling.

missing_SI_or_normalization_items.needed_detail: Distance cutoff, periodic-image handling, and whether all pairs or nearest-neighbor shells are included.
missing_SI_or_normalization_items.why_needed: Directly changes O_s and any overlap-preserving null model.

missing_SI_or_normalization_items.needed_detail: Definitions and units of q_i, q_j or equivalent orbital weights, including treatment of In/Ga/Zn/Sn/O/N centers.
missing_SI_or_normalization_items.why_needed: Prevents uncalibrated equal-weight assumptions from masquerading as the Srivastava metric.

missing_SI_or_normalization_items.needed_detail: Original dependent variable, transforms, fitted coefficients, sample list, and any density/disorder controls used in Srivastava.
missing_SI_or_normalization_items.why_needed: Required before claiming numerical agreement or defeat of graph residuals.

missing_SI_or_normalization_items.needed_detail: Structure IDs, compositions, cell sizes, and any tabulated O_s or m_eff values.
missing_SI_or_normalization_items.why_needed: Needed to create true same-sample rows rather than literature-family joins.

obtainability_in_this_round.reason: The Round 2 instruction constrained project-file reads to the listed files; within that scope the exact Srivastava SI/normalization is absent. The output therefore records a surrogate rather than a reproduced Srivastava implementation.
obtainability_in_this_round.binding_rule: All downstream rows using the surrogate must carry provenance='surrogate:not_srivastava_reproduction'.

formula.pair_set: E_s(r_c) = declared conduction-center pairs within cutoff r_c under periodic boundary conditions
formula.sample_overlap: O_s = sum_{(i,j) in E_s} W_ij / N_pair_s

ell_ij.status: species-pair orbital decay length placeholder; do not call rho_ij in code tables

surrogate_overlap_baseline.allowed_use: screening, schema construction, null-model plumbing, and residual-test dry runs
surrogate_overlap_baseline.forbidden_use: numerical claim that the Srivastava 2019 orbital-overlap metric has been reproduced

beta_2.storage_rule: regression coefficient tables must include coefficient_unit for every fitted beta/gamma/alpha

rho_conflict.problem: Round 1 used rho_ij for orbital decay length and rho_resid_s for spectral-radius residual.

graph_feature_equation_update.old: r_y_s = alpha_0 + alpha_1*lambda2_resid_s + alpha_2*rho_resid_s + alpha_3*damage_resid_s + error_s
graph_feature_equation_update.new: r_y_s = alpha_0 + alpha_1*lambda2_resid_s + alpha_2*spectral_radius_resid_s + alpha_3*damage_resid_s + error_s

column_definitions.O_s: Dimensionless normalized orbital-overlap baseline; may be exact Srivastava metric only if SI constants are available.
column_definitions.DeltaE_s: Mobility-edge margin E_F - E_c in eV.
column_definitions.batch: Synthesis, simulation, or literature batch identifier.
column_definitions.size: Finite-size descriptor such as atom count, cell length, film thickness, or ensemble size.
column_definitions.lambda2_resid_s: Algebraic-connectivity residual after overlap/degree/size controls; placeholder allowed before graph computation.
column_definitions.spectral_radius_resid_s: Spectral-radius residual after degree/weight-preserving controls; avoids rho notation.
column_definitions.external_label: External Hall/Drude/Wannier/spectral observable not used to construct graph features.

size.source_note: mean free path range listed in current/plan/文献库.md; not a structure size

provenance.label_source: current/plan/文献库.md reports m*≈0.2m0 and DeltaE≈0.25 eV for DOI 10.1038/s41567-025-03099-x
provenance.join_status: not same-sample complete until structure/SI and computed O_s/graph residuals are attached

residual_protocol_after_round2.baseline_model: y_s = f_y(O_s, V_s, n_s, DeltaE_s, batch, size) + error_s
residual_protocol_after_round2.external_residual: r_y_s = y_s - f_y(O_s, V_s, n_s, DeltaE_s, batch, size)
residual_protocol_after_round2.graph_residual_test: r_y_s = alpha_0 + alpha_1*lambda2_resid_s + alpha_2*spectral_radius_resid_s + alpha_3*damage_resid_s + error_s
residual_protocol_after_round2.acceptance_condition: Only held-out residual improvement with stable coefficients and exact/same-sample provenance can support further mechanism investigation.
residual_protocol_after_round2.current_status: No acceptance condition is met in this round because exact overlap normalization and complete same-sample rows are still missing.

graph_absorption_claim_status.weighted_degree_mean: protocol hypothesis; likely reparameterizes O_s but not numerically established here
graph_absorption_claim_status.distance_or_coordination_summaries: protocol hypothesis; likely absorbed by overlap baseline when edge definitions match
graph_absorption_claim_status.lambda2_resid_s: admissible placeholder only after overlap/degree/size residualization
graph_absorption_claim_status.spectral_radius_resid_s: admissible placeholder only after degree/weight-preserving controls
graph_absorption_claim_status.damage_resid_s: admissible placeholder only as targeted-minus-matched-random perturbation residual

round2_key_conclusions: Exact Srivastava SI/normalization remains the blocking missing item for numerical reproduction.
A usable surrogate is defined with explicit provenance, but it is not Srivastava reproduction.
At least one same-sample schema row is instantiated; it is a non-decisive literature-candidate row with missing overlap/graph values clearly marked.
beta_2 is corrected to eV^-2 when V_s is in eV^2.
rho notation collision is removed by using ell_ij for orbital decay length and spectral_radius_resid_s for spectral radius.
No material mechanism claim is made.
